question.text: Map the chain from a Aerospace / Defense market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester.

exchange.sent: Map the chain from a Aerospace / Defense market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester.

answer.answer:
已查到可引用的部分資料：

### Short answer
A supported Aerospace / Defense chain is: contested RF / smart-jamming resilience for deployed private 5G → measure handover interruption, RTT, packet loss, jitter, reliability and target application throughput → require a signaling tester / network emulator that can run 5G SA multi-cell scenarios, inter-frequency handovers, IP traffic/application measurements, and controlled RF conditions; the passages support CMX500 for the signaling/network-emulation side, but they do not directly prove a specific non-signaling tester requirement for this Aerospace / Defense chain [2][23][24][26][69].
### Chain mapping
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| The Aerospace & Defense Test presentation topic is deployed 5G private networks in Smart Jamming / EW environments and whether legacy frequency-hopping can improve resilience without modifying the DUT [69]. | The measurable outcome includes handover interruption interval, with modem B never more than 75 ms and modem A up to 150 ms [23]. | The signaling tester needs 5G network emulation for controlled DUT connection testing, because the test setup used R&S CMX500 as a 5G network emulator [2]. | [2][23][69] |
| Mission-critical / tactical 5G testing asks how deployed private 5G connections can maintain service continuity in contested RF / EW environments against Smart Jamming [26]. | The measurable outcome includes RTT, where more than 90% of RTT values were below 20 ms, with 0.1 percentile values near 80 ms for modem B and near 200 ms for modem A [23]. | The signaling tester needs application/IP measurement capability such as Ping, iPerf, throughput, and IP logging, because CMX-KA100 provides Ping, iPerf, throughput, IP logging and related internal IP services [11]. | [11][23][26] |
| The market drivers include tactical edge connectivity, smart jamming and improved EW tactics, contested spectrum, private 5G adoption, autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency, secure command-and-control networks, and tactical private 5G networks on military bases [74]. | The measurable application target includes real-time video stream at least 2 Mbit/s and extended reality at least 30 Mbit/s [22]. | The signaling tester needs application traffic generation and measurement, because the setup used ping at 100 Hz, iPerf updates once per second, and 2 Mbit/s uplink/downlink target data rate [2]. | [2][22][74] |
| The technical mapping for the resilience problem is to 5G handover signaling and 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy FHSS capabilities [24]. | The handover-frequency-hopping prerequisite is highly reliable inter-frequency handovers while carrier frequency changes constantly [24]. | The signaling tester needs multi-cell, multi-frequency 5G SA emulation, because the setup tested three 5G SA cells at n41 / 2.50713 GHz, n78 / 3.30087 GHz and n79 / 4.62399 GHz [2]. | [2][24] |
| The hardening approach uses 5G handover across multiple cells / carrier frequencies so a jammer must constantly listen and readjust to every change [24]. | The measurable worst-case result was data interruptions below 75 ms in 99% of the time when hopping every second and when the next cell was not previously activated [23]. | The signaling tester needs enough RF/cell resources to emulate the scenario, and the cited setup used CMX500 configured with two NR FR1-capable RF units, four RF ports and up to eight cells [2]. | [2][23][24] |
| Public safety agencies, critical infrastructure industries and military purposes require reliable, fast and secure communications, while legacy systems below 30 kbit/s cannot meet video and XR data-rate needs [22]. | The measurable one-hour Microsoft Teams / WebRTC video call result was average RTT 127.8 ms, jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms, lost or discarded packets 0.0095%, and reliability above 99.99% [23]. | The signaling tester needs E2E application and mobility testing capability, because CMX500 is described as supporting RF, protocol, signaling, E2E application, mobility and application testing in the NTN T&M overview [7]. | [7][22][23] |
| The DUT constraint is an unmodified 5G DUT, so the strategy is on network / infrastructure / orchestration around it [22]. | The measurable test should therefore observe DUT behavior during network-side handover/frequency changes rather than requiring DUT modification [22][24]. | The signaling tester needs network-emulation and remote-control workflows around the DUT, because the setup used a control PC to command CMX500 and a measurement PC to command the UE, with the modem accessed through an AT command port [2]. | [2][22][24] |
| CMX500 is positioned as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [12]. | The measurable RF/control setup fixed UE received power at -70.2 dBm, DL/UL pattern 7:2, DL MCS 10, UL MCS 4 and SISO [2]. | The signaling tester needs controlled RF and 5G NR SA configuration capability, because the same setup used 5G SA cells and fixed RF/link parameters [2]. | [2][12] |
| CMX500 Callbox use cases include non-signaling verification, but the cited passages do not directly connect non-signaling verification to the Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming resilience chain [42][69]. | The smart-jamming resilience outcome passages measure handover interruption, RTT, jitter buffer delay, packet loss and reliability, not non-signaling production RF metrics [23]. | The supported tester requirement for this chain is signaling/network-emulation capability; a required non-signaling tester capability for this exact Aerospace / Defense chain is not directly established by the passages [2][23][42][69]. | [2][23][42][69] |
### Product / option facts that can be used in the chain
| Product line | Knowledge-base-confirmed capability | Relevance to the chain | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | CMX500 was used as a 5G network emulator in the August 2025 smart-jamming resilience setup [2]. | This directly supports the signaling/network-emulation side of the chain [2]. | [2] |
| R&S CMX500 | CMX500 supports NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, plus fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement [12]. | These are relevant tester capabilities for controlled 5G signaling and measurement, but the passage does not state that all were used in the smart-jamming test [12]. | [12] |
| R&S CMX500 | R&S CMX-KA100 provides DNS, IMS, Message Center, FTP, HTTP, DNS monitor, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard and web server [11]. | These capabilities align with the cited use of ping, iPerf and throughput/application statistics in the test setup and outcomes [2][11][23]. | [2][11][23] |
| R&S CMX500 | R&S CMX-KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP tune tool and SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings [11]. | Delay measurement is relevant to RTT / interruption analysis, but the passages do not state that CMX-KA110 was used in the smart-jamming test [11][23]. | [11][23] |
| R&S CMX500 | NR signaling option R&S CMX-KS600B / M / X is an NR signaling enabler for Rel. 15 and includes 5G NR SA option 2, NSA option 3, DL 2x2/4x4 MIMO, one CC and UL 256QAM [38]. | This is a knowledge-base-confirmed NR signaling option, but the passages do not state the option stack used in the smart-jamming setup [38]. | [38] |
| R&S CMX500 | CMX500 Callbox example use cases include non-signaling verification [42]. | This supports that non-signaling verification exists as a CMX500 Callbox use case, but it does not establish a required non-signaling capability for the Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming chain [42][69]. | [42][69] |
### 【推論】
【推論】For the Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming resilience chain, the minimum supported signaling-tester capability set is 5G SA network emulation, multi-cell / multi-frequency handover control, controlled RF conditions, and application traffic measurement, because the market need is contested 5G resilience, the technical method is inter-frequency handover frequency hopping, and the setup used CMX500 with three 5G SA cells plus ping/iPerf traffic [2][24][26][69].
【推論】The measurable acceptance focus should be service-continuity metrics rather than only RF parametric metrics, because the cited outcomes are handover interruption interval, RTT, jitter buffer delay, lost/discarded packets and video-call reliability under smart-jammer pressure [23].
【推論】A non-signaling tester may be relevant for separate RF verification workflows, but the provided passages do not prove it as a required capability for the Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming resilience chain, because non-signaling verification is only listed as a CMX500 Callbox use case and is not tied to the cited Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming test [42][69].

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 setup
白皮書中的 August 2025 測試 setup：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 5G network emulator。
- CMX500 configured device 有兩個 [[NR FR1]] capable RF units，四個 RF ports，可建立最多八個 cells。
- control PC command CMX500；measurement PC command UE。
- M.2 modem 透過 USB adapter board 存取 [[AT command]] port，並以 RF cables 直接連到 CMX500 RF ports。
- phones 使用 [[R&S CMU-Z10]] small anechoic chamber 與 [[Mini-Circuits ZN2PD2-63-S+]] RF combiner。
- 測試三個 [[5G SA]] cells：n41 / 2.50713 GHz、n78 / 3.30087 GHz、n79 / 4.62399 GHz。
- UE received power 固定 -70.2 dBm；DL/UL pattern 7:2；DL MCS 10、UL MCS 4；SISO。
- ping 100 Hz；iPerf update 每秒一次；uplink / downlink target data rate 2 Mbit/s。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 與既有頁面的關係
- [[DUT]]：本概念的限制條件是 unmodified 5G DUT。
- [[Handover frequency hopping]]：白皮書中最具體的 implementation。
- [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]：本概念的主要技術方向。
- [[Smart Jamming]]：本概念要處理的 threat model。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：白皮書明示測試使用 CMX500 作為 network emulator；但該 Market source 不是 CMX500 binding specifications。
- [[Counter-UAV 技術]]：簡報 mid-term roadmap 提到 drone detection 與 perimeter defense，但不是 counter-UAV 系統評估來源。
- [[Beamforming]]：簡報短期 roadmap 提到 mmWave phased arrays field testing，但沒有 beamforming 定義或測試方法。

NTN signaling customer discovery
[[NTN signaling customer discovery]] 是用問卷方式蒐集 [[Non-Terrestrial Network]] signaling 測試需求的方法，重點在把 service offering、network configuration、technology release、satellite architecture、UE、QoS、mobility 與 deployment workflow 問清楚，而不是直接宣稱產品能力。

NTN signaling customer discovery › 2. Test layer
來源要求客戶指出要測試哪一層：

- RF
- Protocol
- Application Testing

這表示 discovery 階段需先分清楚測試目標，而不是只用「NTN testing」作為單一需求描述。

NTN signaling customer discovery › 4. Satellite architecture
來源詢問：

- 是否將 CMX 連接到 [[satellite gateway]]，在 real live satellite network 中測試。
- gateway 使用哪些 bands。
- satellite orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- payload type：[[transparent satellite payload]] 或 [[regenerative satellite payload]]。

這些問題把 NTN 測試需求拆成 orbit、payload 與 gateway integration，而不是只停留在 waveform / protocol 名稱。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › 使用限制
- 本頁是 T&M 技術總覽；正式 test methods、limits、tolerances、test case IDs 與 validation status 需查 [[TS 38.101-5]]、[[TS 38.521-5]]、[[TS 38.523]]、[[TS 38.533]]、[[TS 38.181]]、[[TS 38.108]]、GCF / PTCRB public documents。
- R&S 產品能力需以正式 datasheet / configuration guide 為準；白皮書中的 solution-level 描述不可直接作為 quote / BOM / orderable capability。
- OTA / PAAM setup 的 fixtures、antenna modules、chamber dimensions、quiet zone、polarization、frequency conversions 等需以原圖與 setup note 回查。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

CMX500 Callbox › unresolved
- 來源未標示簡報版本、作者、正式發佈日期與對應 CSW software release。
- 多個 use cases 未列出完整 option stack、BOM、DUT 條件或測試報告。
- Roadmap 字樣如 coming soon、coming in 2025 and later、planned for CSW 9.00 / 9.10 需以 release note 或正式 product documentation 補證。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing
[[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中引用 [[RTCA DO-160]] 作為 airborne equipment environmental conditions and test procedures 的測試線索，用於 military / aviation drone EMC proposal context。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 22 — Lightning Induced Transients
來源說此測試確保 equipment can withstand a selection of fast transients intended to represent induced effects of lightning，並在頁面標題中列 [[CS117]]。

軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing › 使用限制
- 本頁是 Market 類簡報摘要，不是 [[MIL-STD-461]]、[[MIL-STD-464]] 或 [[RTCA DO-160]] 標準文件。
- 不可由此頁直接判定任一 drone / UAV / eVTOL 產品必須測哪些項目。
- [[MIL-STD-464C]] / [[MIL-STD-464D]] 版本差異需後續查正式標準或 procurement documentation。
- 系統層 EME / HPM / EMP / lightning / RADHAZ 測試涉及安全與法規限制，來源未提供可部署或可執行參數。

[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 對 system level EME effects test 與 standard EMC test 的差異描述包含：

- system level 依 requirements operate in fixed / operational environment。
- operational environmental conditions may have no definition。
- 分析 EM interference，涵蓋 time and frequency domain。
- standard EMC test 則 according to test methods、frequency domain、research and design work 等。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 問題定義
依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17），簡報的 problem statement 是：

- current vulnerability of 5G [[DUT]] connections under smart-jamming；
- can legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] techniques enhance 5G resilience；
- can the connection to an unmodified 5G DUT be hardened against [[Smart Jamming]] by using legacy FH capabilities。

來源特別強調 constraint：不修改 [[DUT]]；策略應放在 network / infrastructure / orchestration around it。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]（Version 01.00，August 2025）補充：public safety agencies、critical infrastructure industries 與 military purposes 依賴 reliable、fast、secure communications；TETRA 等傳統系統 maximum data bit rate below 30 kbit/s，無法滿足 real-time video stream 至少 2 Mbit/s 與 extended reality 至少 30 Mbit/s 的需求。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 outcome
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 的 outcome 投影片聲稱：

- both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；
- throughput performance 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 被用來評估；
- video-call reliability 在 smart-jammer pressure 下透過 FH-aligned approach 維持；
- 來源口語說明稱 jitter / packet loss contained。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 提供更完整數字：

- modem B 的 HO interruption interval never employs more than 75 ms；modem A 可到 150 ms。
- RTT 大多數時間（> 90%）低於 20 ms；0.1 percentile modem B 接近 80 ms、modem A 接近 200 ms。
- late target cell activation 0–3 s waiting time 的 mean HO interruption interval 均為 68.0 ms，90% 均為 69 ms。
- HO period 5 s 到 1 s 的 mean HO interruption interval 約 67.9–68.0 ms，90% 與 99% 均為 69 ms。
- 一小時 [[Microsoft Teams]] / [[WebRTC]] video call：average RTT 127.8 ms、jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms、lost or discarded packets 0.0095%、reliability > 99.99%。
- 白皮書結論稱最差 scenario（每秒跳頻、且下一個 cell 先前未啟用）下，data interruptions contained below 75 ms in 99% of the time。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 技術映射
來源將 resilience 問題映射到兩類 5G / FH 行為：

1. Mapping to [[5G Handover]] signaling。
2. Mapping to 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy [[FHSS]] capabilities。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 將此具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：使用 [[5G Handover]] 在多個 cells / carrier frequencies 之間切換，使 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change。來源說 prerequisite 是 highly reliable inter-frequency handovers，以便在 constantly changing carrier frequency 時仍維持 dependable communications link。

來源先詢問客戶預計在 NTN 上提供哪些 service，例如：

- [[IoT]]
- broadband
- voice
- other applications

接著詢問 testing environment 是 live network environment（包含 [[satellite gateway]]）還是 simulated environment，以及 NTN service deployment 的 timeline、milestones、deadlines。

NTN signaling customer discovery › 8. QoS and mobility
來源詢問不同 traffic type 是否有 [[Quality of Service]]（[[QoS]]）要求，例如 prioritization 或 guaranteed bandwidth；也詢問 UE mobility pattern，例如 stationary、pedestrian、vehicular 或其他 scenario。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › OTA / phased array / PAAM testing
NTN UE、VSAT、SAN、satellite 可能使用 directive antennas / phased array antennas，因此 OTA testing 重要。

來源整理：

- OTA methods：far field、near field、CATR、plane wave conversion、anechoic chamber、reverberation chamber。
- PAAM metrics：radiation pattern、scan loss、pointing error、HPBW、sidelobe levels、EIRP、G/T、noise density、EVM、beam switching。
- NTN beam metrics：beam center、beam peak、beam pair、beam pointing accuracy、beam stability、beam squint、OSDD、beam shape capability。
- Rohde & Schwarz setups 使用 [[R&S ZNA]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWX]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S ATS800B]]、[[R&S ATS800R]]、[[R&S ATS1800M]] 等。

NTN test and measurement aspects › UE NTN testing
UE NTN testing categories：

- RF testing。
- protocol testing。
- performance testing。
- carrier acceptance testing。
- interoperability testing。

相關規格：

- [[TS 38.101-5]]：satellite NR UE RF and performance requirements。
- [[TS 38.521-5]]：NR UE satellite access RF / performance conformance procedures。
- [[TS 38.523]]：protocol conformance。
- [[TS 38.533]]：RRM conformance。
- [[TS 38.133]]：RRM requirements。

目前 RF tests 多聚焦 FR1；來源預期未來會擴展到 FR2、Ka-band、Ku-band 與 moving satellite conditions。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Mobile network testing（MNT）
來源指出 [[Mobile network testing]] 可擴展至 NTN：

- passive testing：scanner 監測 downlink spectrum，不建立連線。
- active testing：test UE / QualiPoc Android 做 connected mode / E2E QoS / QoE testing。
- NTN MNT metrics 包含 RSRP、RSRQ、RS-SINR、RSSI、spectrum clearance、RTT、packet loss、BLER、throughput、mobility、random access success、SIB decoding、SMS / voice / video QoE。
- DTC LEO 與 Skylo IoT-NTN drive test examples 被作為 MNT early scenarios。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Fading profiles and test channels
來源整理 [[TR 38.811]]、[[TR 38.901]] 與 [[TS 38.181]] 的 NTN channel model / test condition：

- [[CDL]]：clustered delay line，適用於 S-band / Ka-band，含 elevation / azimuth 的 3D model。
- [[TDL]]：tapped delay line，用於 multipath power-delay profile。
- TR 38.811 定義 NTN-CDL 與 NTN-TDL profiles，各有 LOS / NLOS profiles。
- TS 38.181 為 SAN testing 定義 NTN-TDLA100、NTN-TDLC5、moving propagation condition。
- Rel. 19 導入 NGSO time-varying Doppler shift and propagation delay channel model，用於更 realistic demodulation / RRM tests。

來源內有一項需保留的讀法限制：同段中 `NTN-TDLA100-200` 被文字描述為 100 ms delay spread，但表格對 NTN-TDLA100 列 100 ns delay spread。此處需回查原 PDF / TS 38.181。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Mission context 與 industry drivers
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出的 mission / market drivers 包含：

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；
- complex RF environment 與 contested spectrum；
- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
- autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency；
- expansion of tactical private 5G networks on military bases；
- demand for secure command-and-control networks；
- strategic partnerships，例如來源提到 Nokia + L3Harris in 2024；
- multi-year contracts，例如來源提到 Northrop Grumman 5G battlefield networking in 2024。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 另稱 United States Department of Defense has recently embarked on a strategy leveraging both public and private 5G networks，並說 5G could become the de-facto communications network between NATO members。此為 white paper statement；來源未附完整 DoD / NATO 文件引用。

answer.text:
### Short answer
A supported Aerospace / Defense chain is: contested RF / smart-jamming resilience for deployed private 5G → measure handover interruption, RTT, packet loss, jitter, reliability and target application throughput → require a signaling tester / network emulator that can run 5G SA multi-cell scenarios, inter-frequency handovers, IP traffic/application measurements, and controlled RF conditions; the passages support CMX500 for the signaling/network-emulation side, but they do not directly prove a specific non-signaling tester requirement for this Aerospace / Defense chain [2][23][24][26][69].
### Chain mapping
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| The Aerospace & Defense Test presentation topic is deployed 5G private networks in Smart Jamming / EW environments and whether legacy frequency-hopping can improve resilience without modifying the DUT [69]. | The measurable outcome includes handover interruption interval, with modem B never more than 75 ms and modem A up to 150 ms [23]. | The signaling tester needs 5G network emulation for controlled DUT connection testing, because the test setup used R&S CMX500 as a 5G network emulator [2]. | [2][23][69] |
| Mission-critical / tactical 5G testing asks how deployed private 5G connections can maintain service continuity in contested RF / EW environments against Smart Jamming [26]. | The measurable outcome includes RTT, where more than 90% of RTT values were below 20 ms, with 0.1 percentile values near 80 ms for modem B and near 200 ms for modem A [23]. | The signaling tester needs application/IP measurement capability such as Ping, iPerf, throughput, and IP logging, because CMX-KA100 provides Ping, iPerf, throughput, IP logging and related internal IP services [11]. | [11][23][26] |
| The market drivers include tactical edge connectivity, smart jamming and improved EW tactics, contested spectrum, private 5G adoption, autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency, secure command-and-control networks, and tactical private 5G networks on military bases [74]. | The measurable application target includes real-time video stream at least 2 Mbit/s and extended reality at least 30 Mbit/s [22]. | The signaling tester needs application traffic generation and measurement, because the setup used ping at 100 Hz, iPerf updates once per second, and 2 Mbit/s uplink/downlink target data rate [2]. | [2][22][74] |
| The technical mapping for the resilience problem is to 5G handover signaling and 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy FHSS capabilities [24]. | The handover-frequency-hopping prerequisite is highly reliable inter-frequency handovers while carrier frequency changes constantly [24]. | The signaling tester needs multi-cell, multi-frequency 5G SA emulation, because the setup tested three 5G SA cells at n41 / 2.50713 GHz, n78 / 3.30087 GHz and n79 / 4.62399 GHz [2]. | [2][24] |
| The hardening approach uses 5G handover across multiple cells / carrier frequencies so a jammer must constantly listen and readjust to every change [24]. | The measurable worst-case result was data interruptions below 75 ms in 99% of the time when hopping every second and when the next cell was not previously activated [23]. | The signaling tester needs enough RF/cell resources to emulate the scenario, and the cited setup used CMX500 configured with two NR FR1-capable RF units, four RF ports and up to eight cells [2]. | [2][23][24] |
| Public safety agencies, critical infrastructure industries and military purposes require reliable, fast and secure communications, while legacy systems below 30 kbit/s cannot meet video and XR data-rate needs [22]. | The measurable one-hour Microsoft Teams / WebRTC video call result was average RTT 127.8 ms, jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms, lost or discarded packets 0.0095%, and reliability above 99.99% [23]. | The signaling tester needs E2E application and mobility testing capability, because CMX500 is described as supporting RF, protocol, signaling, E2E application, mobility and application testing in the NTN T&M overview [7]. | [7][22][23] |
| The DUT constraint is an unmodified 5G DUT, so the strategy is on network / infrastructure / orchestration around it [22]. | The measurable test should therefore observe DUT behavior during network-side handover/frequency changes rather than requiring DUT modification [22][24]. | The signaling tester needs network-emulation and remote-control workflows around the DUT, because the setup used a control PC to command CMX500 and a measurement PC to command the UE, with the modem accessed through an AT command port [2]. | [2][22][24] |
| CMX500 is positioned as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [12]. | The measurable RF/control setup fixed UE received power at -70.2 dBm, DL/UL pattern 7:2, DL MCS 10, UL MCS 4 and SISO [2]. | The signaling tester needs controlled RF and 5G NR SA configuration capability, because the same setup used 5G SA cells and fixed RF/link parameters [2]. | [2][12] |
| CMX500 Callbox use cases include non-signaling verification, but the cited passages do not directly connect non-signaling verification to the Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming resilience chain [42][69]. | The smart-jamming resilience outcome passages measure handover interruption, RTT, jitter buffer delay, packet loss and reliability, not non-signaling production RF metrics [23]. | The supported tester requirement for this chain is signaling/network-emulation capability; a required non-signaling tester capability for this exact Aerospace / Defense chain is not directly established by the passages [2][23][42][69]. | [2][23][42][69] |
### Product / option facts that can be used in the chain
| Product line | Knowledge-base-confirmed capability | Relevance to the chain | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | CMX500 was used as a 5G network emulator in the August 2025 smart-jamming resilience setup [2]. | This directly supports the signaling/network-emulation side of the chain [2]. | [2] |
| R&S CMX500 | CMX500 supports NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, plus fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement [12]. | These are relevant tester capabilities for controlled 5G signaling and measurement, but the passage does not state that all were used in the smart-jamming test [12]. | [12] |
| R&S CMX500 | R&S CMX-KA100 provides DNS, IMS, Message Center, FTP, HTTP, DNS monitor, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard and web server [11]. | These capabilities align with the cited use of ping, iPerf and throughput/application statistics in the test setup and outcomes [2][11][23]. | [2][11][23] |
| R&S CMX500 | R&S CMX-KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP tune tool and SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings [11]. | Delay measurement is relevant to RTT / interruption analysis, but the passages do not state that CMX-KA110 was used in the smart-jamming test [11][23]. | [11][23] |
| R&S CMX500 | NR signaling option R&S CMX-KS600B / M / X is an NR signaling enabler for Rel. 15 and includes 5G NR SA option 2, NSA option 3, DL 2x2/4x4 MIMO, one CC and UL 256QAM [38]. | This is a knowledge-base-confirmed NR signaling option, but the passages do not state the option stack used in the smart-jamming setup [38]. | [38] |
| R&S CMX500 | CMX500 Callbox example use cases include non-signaling verification [42]. | This supports that non-signaling verification exists as a CMX500 Callbox use case, but it does not establish a required non-signaling capability for the Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming chain [42][69]. | [42][69] |
### 【推論】
【推論】For the Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming resilience chain, the minimum supported signaling-tester capability set is 5G SA network emulation, multi-cell / multi-frequency handover control, controlled RF conditions, and application traffic measurement, because the market need is contested 5G resilience, the technical method is inter-frequency handover frequency hopping, and the setup used CMX500 with three 5G SA cells plus ping/iPerf traffic [2][24][26][69].
【推論】The measurable acceptance focus should be service-continuity metrics rather than only RF parametric metrics, because the cited outcomes are handover interruption interval, RTT, jitter buffer delay, lost/discarded packets and video-call reliability under smart-jammer pressure [23].
【推論】A non-signaling tester may be relevant for separate RF verification workflows, but the provided passages do not prove it as a required capability for the Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming resilience chain, because non-signaling verification is only listed as a CMX500 Callbox use case and is not tied to the cited Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming test [42][69].

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。

- current vulnerability of 5G [[DUT]] connections under smart-jamming；
- can legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] techniques enhance 5G resilience；
- can the connection to an unmodified 5G DUT be hardened against [[Smart Jamming]] by using legacy FH capabilities。

NTN signaling customer discovery
[[NTN signaling customer discovery]] 是用問卷方式蒐集 [[Non-Terrestrial Network]] signaling 測試需求的方法，重點在把 service offering、network configuration、technology release、satellite architecture、UE、QoS、mobility 與 deployment workflow 問清楚，而不是直接宣稱產品能力。

NTN signaling customer discovery › 2. Test layer
來源要求客戶指出要測試哪一層：

- RF
- Protocol
- Application Testing

這表示 discovery 階段需先分清楚測試目標，而不是只用「NTN testing」作為單一需求描述。

NTN signaling customer discovery › 4. Satellite architecture
來源詢問：

- 是否將 CMX 連接到 [[satellite gateway]]，在 real live satellite network 中測試。
- gateway 使用哪些 bands。
- satellite orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- payload type：[[transparent satellite payload]] 或 [[regenerative satellite payload]]。

這些問題把 NTN 測試需求拆成 orbit、payload 與 gateway integration，而不是只停留在 waveform / protocol 名稱。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › 使用限制
- 本頁是 T&M 技術總覽；正式 test methods、limits、tolerances、test case IDs 與 validation status 需查 [[TS 38.101-5]]、[[TS 38.521-5]]、[[TS 38.523]]、[[TS 38.533]]、[[TS 38.181]]、[[TS 38.108]]、GCF / PTCRB public documents。
- R&S 產品能力需以正式 datasheet / configuration guide 為準；白皮書中的 solution-level 描述不可直接作為 quote / BOM / orderable capability。
- OTA / PAAM setup 的 fixtures、antenna modules、chamber dimensions、quiet zone、polarization、frequency conversions 等需以原圖與 setup note 回查。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。

- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。

[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。

[[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中引用 [[RTCA DO-160]] 作為 airborne equipment environmental conditions and test procedures 的測試線索，用於 military / aviation drone EMC proposal context。

來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說此測試確保 equipment can withstand a selection of fast transients intended to represent induced effects of lightning，並在頁面標題中列 [[CS117]]。

- [[IoT]]
- broadband

NTN signaling customer discovery › 8. QoS and mobility
來源詢問不同 traffic type 是否有 [[Quality of Service]]（[[QoS]]）要求，例如 prioritization 或 guaranteed bandwidth；也詢問 UE mobility pattern，例如 stationary、pedestrian、vehicular 或其他 scenario。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › OTA / phased array / PAAM testing
NTN UE、VSAT、SAN、satellite 可能使用 directive antennas / phased array antennas，因此 OTA testing 重要。

來源整理：

- OTA methods：far field、near field、CATR、plane wave conversion、anechoic chamber、reverberation chamber。
- PAAM metrics：radiation pattern、scan loss、pointing error、HPBW、sidelobe levels、EIRP、G/T、noise density、EVM、beam switching。
- NTN beam metrics：beam center、beam peak、beam pair、beam pointing accuracy、beam stability、beam squint、OSDD、beam shape capability。
- Rohde & Schwarz setups 使用 [[R&S ZNA]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWX]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S ATS800B]]、[[R&S ATS800R]]、[[R&S ATS1800M]] 等。

NTN test and measurement aspects › UE NTN testing
UE NTN testing categories：

- RF testing。
- protocol testing。
- performance testing。
- carrier acceptance testing。
- interoperability testing。

相關規格：

- [[TS 38.101-5]]：satellite NR UE RF and performance requirements。
- [[TS 38.521-5]]：NR UE satellite access RF / performance conformance procedures。
- [[TS 38.523]]：protocol conformance。
- [[TS 38.533]]：RRM conformance。
- [[TS 38.133]]：RRM requirements。

目前 RF tests 多聚焦 FR1；來源預期未來會擴展到 FR2、Ka-band、Ku-band 與 moving satellite conditions。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Mobile network testing（MNT）
來源指出 [[Mobile network testing]] 可擴展至 NTN：

- passive testing：scanner 監測 downlink spectrum，不建立連線。
- active testing：test UE / QualiPoc Android 做 connected mode / E2E QoS / QoE testing。
- NTN MNT metrics 包含 RSRP、RSRQ、RS-SINR、RSSI、spectrum clearance、RTT、packet loss、BLER、throughput、mobility、random access success、SIB decoding、SMS / voice / video QoE。
- DTC LEO 與 Skylo IoT-NTN drive test examples 被作為 MNT early scenarios。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Fading profiles and test channels
來源整理 [[TR 38.811]]、[[TR 38.901]] 與 [[TS 38.181]] 的 NTN channel model / test condition：

- [[CDL]]：clustered delay line，適用於 S-band / Ka-band，含 elevation / azimuth 的 3D model。
- [[TDL]]：tapped delay line，用於 multipath power-delay profile。
- TR 38.811 定義 NTN-CDL 與 NTN-TDL profiles，各有 LOS / NLOS profiles。
- TS 38.181 為 SAN testing 定義 NTN-TDLA100、NTN-TDLC5、moving propagation condition。
- Rel. 19 導入 NGSO time-varying Doppler shift and propagation delay channel model，用於更 realistic demodulation / RRM tests。

來源內有一項需保留的讀法限制：同段中 `NTN-TDLA100-200` 被文字描述為 100 ms delay spread，但表格對 NTN-TDLA100 列 100 ns delay spread。此處需回查原 PDF / TS 38.181。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Mission context 與 industry drivers

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；
- complex RF environment 與 contested spectrum；
- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
- autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency；

answer.text:
### Short answer
A supported Aerospace / Defense chain is: contested RF / smart-jamming resilience for deployed private 5G → measure handover interruption, RTT, packet loss, jitter, reliability and target application throughput → require a signaling tester / network emulator that can run 5G SA multi-cell scenarios, inter-frequency handovers, IP traffic/application measurements, and controlled RF conditions; the passages support CMX500 for the signaling/network-emulation side, but they do not directly prove a specific non-signaling tester requirement for this Aerospace / Defense chain [2][23][24][26][69].
### Chain mapping
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| The Aerospace & Defense Test presentation topic is deployed 5G private networks in Smart Jamming / EW environments and whether legacy frequency-hopping can improve resilience without modifying the DUT [69]. | The measurable outcome includes handover interruption interval, with modem B never more than 75 ms and modem A up to 150 ms [23]. | The signaling tester needs 5G network emulation for controlled DUT connection testing, because the test setup used R&S CMX500 as a 5G network emulator [2]. | [2][23][69] |
| Mission-critical / tactical 5G testing asks how deployed private 5G connections can maintain service continuity in contested RF / EW environments against Smart Jamming [26]. | The measurable outcome includes RTT, where more than 90% of RTT values were below 20 ms, with 0.1 percentile values near 80 ms for modem B and near 200 ms for modem A [23]. | The signaling tester needs application/IP measurement capability such as Ping, iPerf, throughput, and IP logging, because CMX-KA100 provides Ping, iPerf, throughput, IP logging and related internal IP services [11]. | [11][23][26] |
| The market drivers include tactical edge connectivity, smart jamming and improved EW tactics, contested spectrum, private 5G adoption, autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency, secure command-and-control networks, and tactical private 5G networks on military bases [74]. | The measurable application target includes real-time video stream at least 2 Mbit/s and extended reality at least 30 Mbit/s [22]. | The signaling tester needs application traffic generation and measurement, because the setup used ping at 100 Hz, iPerf updates once per second, and 2 Mbit/s uplink/downlink target data rate [2]. | [2][22][74] |
| The technical mapping for the resilience problem is to 5G handover signaling and 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy FHSS capabilities [24]. | The handover-frequency-hopping prerequisite is highly reliable inter-frequency handovers while carrier frequency changes constantly [24]. | The signaling tester needs multi-cell, multi-frequency 5G SA emulation, because the setup tested three 5G SA cells at n41 / 2.50713 GHz, n78 / 3.30087 GHz and n79 / 4.62399 GHz [2]. | [2][24] |
| The hardening approach uses 5G handover across multiple cells / carrier frequencies so a jammer must constantly listen and readjust to every change [24]. | The measurable worst-case result was data interruptions below 75 ms in 99% of the time when hopping every second and when the next cell was not previously activated [23]. | The signaling tester needs enough RF/cell resources to emulate the scenario, and the cited setup used CMX500 configured with two NR FR1-capable RF units, four RF ports and up to eight cells [2]. | [2][23][24] |
| Public safety agencies, critical infrastructure industries and military purposes require reliable, fast and secure communications, while legacy systems below 30 kbit/s cannot meet video and XR data-rate needs [22]. | The measurable one-hour Microsoft Teams / WebRTC video call result was average RTT 127.8 ms, jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms, lost or discarded packets 0.0095%, and reliability above 99.99% [23]. | The signaling tester needs E2E application and mobility testing capability, because CMX500 is described as supporting RF, protocol, signaling, E2E application, mobility and application testing in the NTN T&M overview [7]. | [7][22][23] |
| The DUT constraint is an unmodified 5G DUT, so the strategy is on network / infrastructure / orchestration around it [22]. | The measurable test should therefore observe DUT behavior during network-side handover/frequency changes rather than requiring DUT modification [22][24]. | The signaling tester needs network-emulation and remote-control workflows around the DUT, because the setup used a control PC to command CMX500 and a measurement PC to command the UE, with the modem accessed through an AT command port [2]. | [2][22][24] |
| CMX500 is positioned as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [12]. | The measurable RF/control setup fixed UE received power at -70.2 dBm, DL/UL pattern 7:2, DL MCS 10, UL MCS 4 and SISO [2]. | The signaling tester needs controlled RF and 5G NR SA configuration capability, because the same setup used 5G SA cells and fixed RF/link parameters [2]. | [2][12] |
| CMX500 Callbox use cases include non-signaling verification, but the cited passages do not directly connect non-signaling verification to the Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming resilience chain [42][69]. | The smart-jamming resilience outcome passages measure handover interruption, RTT, jitter buffer delay, packet loss and reliability, not non-signaling production RF metrics [23]. | The supported tester requirement for this chain is signaling/network-emulation capability; a required non-signaling tester capability for this exact Aerospace / Defense chain is not directly established by the passages [2][23][42][69]. | [2][23][42][69] |
### Product / option facts that can be used in the chain
| Product line | Knowledge-base-confirmed capability | Relevance to the chain | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | CMX500 was used as a 5G network emulator in the August 2025 smart-jamming resilience setup [2]. | This directly supports the signaling/network-emulation side of the chain [2]. | [2] |
| R&S CMX500 | CMX500 supports NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, plus fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement [12]. | These are relevant tester capabilities for controlled 5G signaling and measurement, but the passage does not state that all were used in the smart-jamming test [12]. | [12] |
| R&S CMX500 | R&S CMX-KA100 provides DNS, IMS, Message Center, FTP, HTTP, DNS monitor, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard and web server [11]. | These capabilities align with the cited use of ping, iPerf and throughput/application statistics in the test setup and outcomes [2][11][23]. | [2][11][23] |
| R&S CMX500 | R&S CMX-KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP tune tool and SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings [11]. | Delay measurement is relevant to RTT / interruption analysis, but the passages do not state that CMX-KA110 was used in the smart-jamming test [11][23]. | [11][23] |
| R&S CMX500 | NR signaling option R&S CMX-KS600B / M / X is an NR signaling enabler for Rel. 15 and includes 5G NR SA option 2, NSA option 3, DL 2x2/4x4 MIMO, one CC and UL 256QAM [38]. | This is a knowledge-base-confirmed NR signaling option, but the passages do not state the option stack used in the smart-jamming setup [38]. | [38] |
| R&S CMX500 | CMX500 Callbox example use cases include non-signaling verification [42]. | This supports that non-signaling verification exists as a CMX500 Callbox use case, but it does not establish a required non-signaling capability for the Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming chain [42][69]. | [42][69] |
### 【推論】
【推論】For the Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming resilience chain, the minimum supported signaling-tester capability set is 5G SA network emulation, multi-cell / multi-frequency handover control, controlled RF conditions, and application traffic measurement, because the market need is contested 5G resilience, the technical method is inter-frequency handover frequency hopping, and the setup used CMX500 with three 5G SA cells plus ping/iPerf traffic [2][24][26][69].
【推論】The measurable acceptance focus should be service-continuity metrics rather than only RF parametric metrics, because the cited outcomes are handover interruption interval, RTT, jitter buffer delay, lost/discarded packets and video-call reliability under smart-jammer pressure [23].
【推論】A non-signaling tester may be relevant for separate RF verification workflows, but the provided passages do not prove it as a required capability for the Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming resilience chain, because non-signaling verification is only listed as a CMX500 Callbox use case and is not tied to the cited Aerospace / Defense smart-jamming test [42][69].

- can legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] techniques enhance 5G resilience；

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 outcome
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 的 outcome 投影片聲稱：

- both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；
- throughput performance 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 被用來評估；
- video-call reliability 在 smart-jammer pressure 下透過 FH-aligned approach 維持；
- 來源口語說明稱 jitter / packet loss contained。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 提供更完整數字：

- modem B 的 HO interruption interval never employs more than 75 ms；modem A 可到 150 ms。
- RTT 大多數時間（> 90%）低於 20 ms；0.1 percentile modem B 接近 80 ms、modem A 接近 200 ms。
- late target cell activation 0–3 s waiting time 的 mean HO interruption interval 均為 68.0 ms，90% 均為 69 ms。
- HO period 5 s 到 1 s 的 mean HO interruption interval 約 67.9–68.0 ms，90% 與 99% 均為 69 ms。
- 一小時 [[Microsoft Teams]] / [[WebRTC]] video call：average RTT 127.8 ms、jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms、lost or discarded packets 0.0095%、reliability > 99.99%。
- 白皮書結論稱最差 scenario（每秒跳頻、且下一個 cell 先前未啟用）下，data interruptions contained below 75 ms in 99% of the time。

來源將 resilience 問題映射到兩類 5G / FH 行為：

1. Mapping to [[5G Handover]] signaling。
2. Mapping to 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy [[FHSS]] capabilities。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 將此具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：使用 [[5G Handover]] 在多個 cells / carrier frequencies 之間切換，使 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change。來源說 prerequisite 是 highly reliable inter-frequency handovers，以便在 constantly changing carrier frequency 時仍維持 dependable communications link。
